tagline: Guardrail frameworks, prompt injection and jailbreak detectors, PII filters, safety classifiers and red-teaming tools for LLM apps.
scope: It is about keeping LLM inputs and outputs safe and in policy, not general application security.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: chat messages travel a lane between red guardrails toward a model block, pass through a shield gate and come out checked, while a red warning message hits the shield and is thrown back.
